remarks: Welcome to this immaculate corner unit in the highly sought-after Greenwich Hills community! Elevated on a hilltop, this home offers views of the lush grounds and a tranquil pond, providing a serene and picturesque setting. Experience the perfect blend of privacy, modern updates, and resort-style amenities in one of Greenwich's most desirable communities. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a sun-filled, open-concept first floor. This space features a spacious living and dining area with fireplace and sliding doors that lead to a private patio and yard, perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. The kitchen is a chef's delight, boasting new stainless steel appliances, a convenient breakfast bar, and ample cabinet space for all your culinary needs. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary suite complete with a walk-in closet and an ensuite bath, offering a private retreat for relaxation. A second bedroom, hall bath, and a convenient laundry closet complete this level, ensuring comfort and practicality. The finished lower level offers flexible space, making it perfect for a family room, home gym, or a third bedroom. This versatile area can be tailored to suit your lifestyle needs. Additional highlights include two garages, community tennis courts, & pool. Enjoy the perfect blend of privacy, modern updates, and resort-style amenities in one of Greenwich's most desirable communities.
